adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the SDK call in refreshOAuthTokens(). The refreshOAuthTokens function (in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts) returns either a raw fetch Response when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, or the result of refreshFunction() otherwise. In the HubSpot case, refreshFunction returns the SDK's tokensApi.createToken() result (a HubspotToken object). However, when credential sync is enabled, the function returns a raw fetch Response instead. The code then assigns this to `hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken`, which would be incorrect - a Response object doesn't have the same shape as HubspotToken. This would cause the subsequent code that accesses hubspotRefreshToken properties to fail or produce incorrect values.
